sections.content_text: Section 98 - Deductions of Tax on amount paid by Cellular Mobile Phone Operator The chief executive of a cellular mobile phone operator company, when depositing or paying to the regulatory authority in respect of any revenue distribution or any license fee or any other fee or charge, by whatever name called, whichever occurs earlier, tax will be deducted at the rate of (ten percent) of the said amount.
